title: QIDI Box: heater fan threshold of your own that survives the screen rewriting box.cfg (QIDI_Q2 #25)
note: The screen program owns box.cfg: at every start it builds the file again from a template inside the program (heater_temp_box_heater_fan_0/1: 35) and, when the file on disk differs, writes the template over it and restarts Klipper (log line 初始化写入并重启 Klipper). Same in 03.02. The threshold is therefore kept in saved_variables.cfg (box_fan_temp) and applied to every box_heater_fan object when Klipper connects. QIDI's files are not changed. Tested on a printer without a Box (command, saving, Klipper start); the fan objects themselves are tested offline with stand-ins - no Box available.
